name: git
title: Git
description: Run Git here, never through shell. An array runs in order and stops on failure; batch read-only commands in one. diff for known changes, status to discover them; history only when needed. git diff or git diff -- <paths> includes untracked files. Set include_stage_ids:true to select changes, then action:stage with diff_id/change_ids. Staging rejects stale or cross-Project diffs and returns per-file staged counts. Worktrees are Lead-managed: only worktree_action:list and git worktree list work; every other worktree operation is refused.

action.description: Default command. stage uses diff_id/change_ids instead of command. worktree uses worktree_action.

command.description: Full commands starting with git; shell-style quoting, no pipes/redirects/substitution (a && chain runs as the array). Mutations allowed.

output_limit.description: Body line cap; staging IDs are not capped. Default 500; git log defaults to 100. A cut ends with [output capped …] naming how to continue.

include_stage_ids.description: Include staging IDs outside the body cap for git diff or git diff -- <paths> only. Default false.

diff_id.description: stage: exact diff_id from git diff.

change_ids.description: stage: exact change ID or IDs to stage, including new files.
